description:
#Triton's Love Boat Sunset Charter 💘 

Hop on board with your Valentine and fill your picnic basket with Little Frenchie’s buffet bites. Then find your picnic set up and get cozy for your sunset cruise! Don’t forget to grab our sweetheart bar special, or your favorite Triton cocktail and enjoy sail-abrating love! 

This Valentine's event takes place at [2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA 92106](https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106097016057293421045)
what_is_included:
- 4:30-7pm Charter ❤️⛵️
- Welcome champagne 🥂
- Full buffet by Little Frenchie to fill your picnic basket with 🧺
- Picnic set-up for you and your Valentine 💐
- Fully stocked bar 🍹
- Please arrive by 4pm to check in and sail away by 4:30pm!

Buffet Menu:
- Poached Shrimp with Vadouvan Avocado
- Quiche Bites
- Crudité Cup with French Onion Dip & Seasonal Vegetables
- Jambon Sandwich with Cold Soup
- Puff Pastry with Sliced Roast Beef & Cornichon
- Pâté on Brioche
- Assorted Cookies
- Chocolate-Covered Strawberries
